clips.title: The story
paras: Itharius's Cave is a secluded hollow tucked into the far southwestern cliffs of the Swamp of Sorrows. It serves as the refuge of the enigmatic Itharius, who appears to be a high elf and tends to the brood of green dragonkin inhabiting the surrounding marsh.

Tucked away in the treacherous, moss-draped crags of the southwestern Swamp of Sorrows, this damp cavern shelters the recluse Itharius. Outside its mouth, unruly green whelps wander the mire. Though he appears to be a high elf, a folk who rarely wander so far south into wild swamps alone, Itharius keeps a watchful eye on these young dragonkin as they grow, living alongside them in quiet isolation.
